name: Additive Manufacturing
summary: Building parts layer by layer: the seven AM process families, materials, design for AM, process physics, post-processing and qualification.

topics.name: AM process categories (ISO/ASTM 52900) and the digital workflow (CAD, STL/3MF, slicing)
Powder bed fusion: polymer (SLS, MJF) and metal (LPBF, EBM)
Directed energy deposition and wire-arc AM
Binder jetting, material jetting and sheet lamination
AM materials: polymers, metals, composites and ceramics
Design for additive manufacturing: overhangs, supports, orientation, part consolidation
Process physics, defects, residual stress and anisotropy
Post-processing: support removal, heat treatment, HIP, machining and finishing
Qualification, inspection and standards for AM parts
AM economics and applications (tooling, medical, aerospace, robotics)
